evals.prompt: In FIXTURES/unreleased, update CHANGELOG.md by inspecting every commit from the latest release date inclusively. Curate meaningful changes for affected readers, regardless of commit format. I have not said these changes shipped. Reconcile existing entries and reverts, preserve published history, and suggest the next SemVer version using the documented compatibility contract. Then run the same changelog update again and report whether the second pass changed anything. Modify only CHANGELOG.md and save a report of your evidence and checks.
evals.expected_output: Unreleased contains the existing reports feature once and the completed-course visibility fix once, omits the reverted reminders and internal test changes, and preserves version 1.4.0. All seven candidate commits, including two on the release date, are accounted for. Version 1.5.0 is proposed. The second pass makes no changes.
assertions: Unreleased contains exactly one reports feature and one completed-course visibility fix.
Reverted reminders and internal test-only changes do not appear as pending changes.
Published 1.4.0 content is unchanged and no released section is created.
All seven commits on or after the inclusive release date are accounted for.
The proposed next stable version is 1.5.0 and a second pass makes no edits.
Only CHANGELOG.md changes; no commits, tags, workflows, or manifest edits are created.

evals.prompt: In FIXTURES/released, maintain CHANGELOG.md after reviewing every commit from the latest release date inclusively. All changes under review have shipped as version 2.0.0 on 2026-11-02. Use Keep a Changelog and Semantic Versioning, inspect diffs rather than relying on commit wording, and preserve historical entries. Modify only the changelog; save a report explaining coverage and the version decision.
evals.expected_output: An empty Unreleased remains above 2.0.0 dated 2026-11-02. Changed contains a clear breaking API field replacement with upgrade action and a verified local migration link; Fixed contains the visibility fix. The old release remains intact and package.json remains at 1.4.0. No endpoint or tag is demanded.
assertions: A unique 2.0.0 section dated 2026-11-02 appears below an empty Unreleased section.
The breaking API replacement names status_old and status, states the required action, and links to the existing migration document.
The visibility fix appears under Fixed and published 1.4.0 content is unchanged.
All three candidate commits are accounted for and the major bump is justified by the documented contract.
Only CHANGELOG.md changes; package.json stays at 1.4.0 and no endpoint or tag is required.

evals.prompt: In FIXTURES/bootstrap, create a changelog from our commits, following Keep a Changelog and Semantic Versioning. We do not have a changelog yet. Please save your response and any questions in a report; do not guess missing historical release information.
evals.expected_output: No changelog or historical release is fabricated. The response asks for a starting boundary and initial/current version, and clarifies the 0.x versioning policy if needed. No project files change.
assertions: No changelog or historical release is fabricated and no project file changes.
The response asks for a starting boundary and initial/current version rather than treating all history as the first release.
